answer: Problem: clone farms flood seats because new keys are cheap. Mechanism: each applicant posts a decaying delta bond equal to the 14-day median first payout, locked behind an opal seal with unseal shares at seven neighbors from a rotating atlas. Cost: 1.8 times that median plus 3 unbond epochs. Verification: unsealing needs 5-of-7 signatures on a live activity proof hashed with the bond id; the committee rotates each epoch. Failure: fewer than five signatures, or a later slash of a signer, burns 60% and pays 40% to honest signers; a second miss in four epochs bars challenges for 12 epochs.
